source.teamDataNote: Teams are frozen as numbered ranges in the generator from both TCDB base checklist pages; insert teams are mapped to their same-name base subjects. The generator does not fetch TCDB.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: One complete 120-card Base checklist #1-120, including the 30 Diamond Debuts #91-120; one complete 120-card checklist for each of Double, Triple, and Quadruple. Five insert or insert-parallel checklists make 606 total collector entries across nine ProductSets.
decisions.shortPrints: Diamond Debut base cards were inserted approximately 1:4 original Hobby packs. The VCS Base ProductSet has uniform card availability, so the physical subset rate cannot be modeled separately without breaking the 120-card collector checklist.
decisions.serialExceptions: Double, Triple, and Quadruple card-specific print limits are stored per card, including separate Diamond Debut limits and special #18 Sammy Sosa, #76 Ken Griffey Jr., and #80 Mark McGwire limits.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: No RC suffixes. BaseballCardPedia states the set has no true rookie cards; TCDB's rookie index has zero flagged cards. Diamond Debut is a subset title, not a rookie designation.
decisions.packOdds: The source records 30 Hobby packs per box, six cards per pack and a physical 1:4 rate for Diamond Debuts, but does not publish verified per-pack rates for complete parallel and insert checklists. All ProductSet odds are null pending verified figures. Do not infer odds from serial-number limits.
decisions.relics: A Piece of History has six game-used bat cards with stated PR350 each, not serial numbered.
decisions.releaseSafety: Keep unreleased until card images, pack and box art, pricing, and pack insertion odds are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: #1-90 short set and #91-120 Diamond Debut short prints in one 120-card collector checklist. Physical Diamond Debut odds 1:4 Hobby packs; flattened within VCS Base.

productSets.name: Double Diamond

productSets.name: Triple Diamond

productSets.name: Quadruple Diamond

productSets.name: Diamond Dominance

productSets.name: Diamond Dominance Emerald
productSets.notes: D1-D30 one-of-one insert parallel. Historical pack odds unpublished.

productSets.name: Mystery Numbers

productSets.name: Mystery Numbers Emerald

productSets.name: A Piece of History
